chunks: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) used to say: 'Rest your souls with the splendid wisdom, for indeed they grow weary just as bodies grow weary.'

key_terms.بَدِيعِ الْحِكْمَةِ: Wondrous/splendid wisdom — referring to profound, original, and beautiful knowledge
key_terms.تَكِلُّ: To grow dull, weary, or blunted — used for a blade losing sharpness or a being losing energy
key_terms.رَوِّحُوا: Imperative: refresh, give respite, allow to breathe — derived from rāḥa (rest, spirit, breath of wind)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about resting the soul with wisdom?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) counseled his followers to refresh their souls through the contemplation of sublime wisdom, drawing a vivid parallel between spiritual and bodily exhaustion. Just as the body requires rest and restoration, the soul too needs renewal — and that renewal comes through engaging with profound and beautiful ideas. This teaching reflects the Imam's deep concern for the holistic wellbeing of believers, recognizing that intellectual and spiritual fatigue is as real as physical fatigue.
